variants.title: Thermo-emf of an iron-constantan thermocouple by a null method, and calibration
variants.unknown: the thermo-emf per degree of iron-constantan at 50 °C
variants.note: Iron-constantan gives about 30 % more emf per degree than copper-constantan: 5.269 mV at 100 °C against 4.279 mV.

source.title: NIST ITS-90 thermocouple tables, type J (iron-constantan): 2.585 mV at 50 °C, 5.269 mV at 100 °C, cold junction at 0 °C

variants.aim: Heat one junction of an iron-constantan thermocouple in a water bath, keep the other in melting ice, balance the thermo-emf on a potentiometer and plot the calibration curve.
